sloka: ततः कपिः तं प्रसमीभ्य गर्वितं जितश्रमं शत्रुपराजयोर्जितम् ।अवैक्षताक्षः समुदीर्णमानसः स बाणपाणिः प्रगृहीतकार्मुकः ।। ५.४७.११।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ kapiḥ taṁ prasamībhya garvitaṁ jitaśramaṁ śatruparājayorjitam ।avaikṣatākṣaḥ samudīrṇamānasaḥ sa bāṇapāṇiḥ pragṛhītakārmukaḥ ।। 5.47.11।।।।

translations.english: Then Aksha contempuously looked at Hanuman who had conquered his fatigue and was determined to defeat the enemy. Holding in his hands his bow and arrows proudly, he reflected.
translations.hindi: त्वया विज्ञातपूर्वश्च वाली वानरपुङ्गवः । रासेण निहतः संख्ये शरेणैकेन वानरः
